testcase.name: Scenario: Hide and restore a panel while editing a sketch: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/panel-visibility-snapshot/checkout/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:319:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Hide and restore a panel while editing a sketch ✔ Given an existing sketch is being edited in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full Sketch ribbon displays the Pattern panel and the Finish action ✔ When the user right-clicks the Sketch tab ✔ And the user opens Show Panels ✔ Then Pattern is checked in the panel list ✔ When the user selects Pattern ✔ Then the menus close and the Pattern panel disappears from the ribbon ✔ And the remaining ribbon panels reflow and Finish remains visible ✔ When the user reopens Show Panels from the Sketch tab context menu ✔ Then Pattern is unchecked ✔ When the user selects Pattern ✔ Then the Pattern panel returns to the Sketch ribbon ✔ And Finish remains visible
